name: pUC19
description: High-copy cloning vector with lacZ-alpha blue-white selection, ampicillin resistance, and versatile MCS. Workhorse of molecular cloning.

metadata.note: Beta-lactamase promoter: the 105 bp upstream of the bla start codon (identical to pBR322)
High-copy pMB1/ColE1 origin of replication carrying the pUC copy-number mutation; RNA II promoter to the replication start
lacZ-alpha ORF (107 aa) with the in-frame MCS; translation-verified
Multiple cloning site: EcoRI, SacI, KpnI, SmaI/XmaI, BamHI, XbaI, SalI, SbfI, PstI, SphI, HindIII (each cuts pUC19 only here)

provenance.source: Motif curated reference data for the pUC19 cloning vector. Nucleotide sequence is GenBank L09137.2 (the common 2,686 bp numbering: EcoRI at 396, HindIII at 447), retrieved from NCBI on 2026-09-22, and cross-verified byte-for-byte as the same circular molecule against GenBank M77789.2 (pUC19, opposite strand) and the Addgene vector database (entry 4497).
